sloka: स राज्यम् राघवः पातु भवत्वम् विगतज्वरा ।न हि ते राघवादन्यः क्षमः पुरवरे वसेत् ॥२-३५-३४॥
transliteration: sa rājyam rāghavaḥ pātu bhavatvam vigatajvarā ।na hi te rāghavādanyaḥ kṣamaḥ puravare vaset ॥2-35-34॥

translations.english: Therefore, let Rama potect this kingdom. Be relieved of mental afflictions. There is no other person in this excellent city more competent than Rama to rule this kingdom.
